.step-title{font-family:'Instrument Serif',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:24px;color:var(--paper);margin-bottom:10px;line-height:1.2}
.step-body{font-size:11px;line-height:1.8;color:rgba(242,237,230,.4)}
/* scramble animation triggered by JS */
.scramble{display:inline}
/* bar that fills on hover */
.step-bar{height:1px;background:var(--border);margin-top:16px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.step-bar::after{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:0;height:100%;width:0;background:var(--acid);transition:width .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.step:hover .step-bar::after{width:100%}
/* ══════════════════════════════════════
SECTION: LOGOS — horizontal tape
══════════════════════════════════════ */
.logos-section{padding:80px 0;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.logos-label{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(242,237,230,.2);text-align:center;margin-bottom:40px}
.logos-tape{display:flex;gap:0;width:max-content;animation:tape-scroll 20s linear infinite}
.logos-tape:hover{animation-play-state:paused}
.logo-cell{padding:20px 48px;border-right:.5px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;white-space:nowrap;transition:opacity .3s}
.logo-cell:hover{opacity:1 !important}
.logo-name{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:.1em;color:rgba(242,237,230,.18)}
.logo-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--border)}
@keyframes tape-scroll{to{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
/* fade edges */
.logos-section::before,.logos-section::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;width:120px;z-index:2;pointer-events:none}
.logos-section::before{left:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--ink),transparent)}
.logos-section::after{right:0;background:linear-gradient(-90deg,var(--ink),transparent)}
/* ══════════════════════════════════════
SECTION: INTEGRATIONS — svg path draw
══════════════════════════════════════ */
.integrations{padding:120px 48px;position:relative}
.integ-inner{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:80px;align-items:center}
.integ-text{}
.integ-headline{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(48px,6vw,80px);line-height:.92;margin-bottom:20px}
.integ-headline em{font-family:'Instrument Serif',serif;font-style:italic;color:var(--acid)}
.integ-body{font-size:12px;line-height:1.9;color:rgba(242,237,230,.4);max-width:360px;margin-bottom:32px}
.integ-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px}
.chip{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:6px 12px;border:.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:2px;color:rgba(242,237,230,.4);transition:all .2s}
.chip:hover{border-color:var(--acid);color:var(--acid)}
/* SVG web */
.integ-viz{position:relative;width:100%;aspect-ratio:1;max-width:480px;justify-self:center}
.integ-svg{width:100%;height:100%}
.node-path{stroke:rgba(212,255,71,.15);stroke-width:.5;fill:none;stroke-dasharray:200;stroke-dashoffset:200;transition:stroke .3s}
.node-path.drawn{animation:path-draw 1.2s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) forwards}
@keyframes path-draw{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}
.node-circle{fill:var(--ink);stroke:rgba(212,255,71,.3);stroke-width:.5;transition:all .3s}
.node-circle:hover{stroke:var(--acid);stroke-width:1.5}
.node-label{font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:9px;fill:rgba(242,237,230,.4);text-anchor:middle;dominant-baseline:central;pointer-events:none}
.node-center{fill:var(--acid);opacity:.9}
.node-center-label{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:11px;fill:var(--ink);text-anchor:middle;dominant-baseline:central;pointer-events:none;letter-spacing:.05em}
/* pulse ring */
.pulse-ring{fill:none;stroke:var(--acid);stroke-width:.5;transform-origin:center;animation:pulse-out 3s ease-out infinite;opacity:0}
.pulse-ring:nth-child(2){animation-delay:1s}
.pulse-ring:nth-child(3){animation-delay:2s}
@keyframes pulse-out{0%{r:20px;opacity:.6}100%{r:60px;opacity:0}}
/* ══════════════════════════════════════
SECTION: TESTIMONIALS — split parallax
══════════════════════════════════════ */
.testimonials{padding:0;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.testi-header{padding:80px 48px 0;text-align:center}
.testi-headline{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(48px,6vw,80px);line-height:.92;margin-bottom:8px}
.testi-headline em{font-family:'Instrument Serif',serif;font-style:italic;color:rgba(242,237,230,.25)}
/* Two columns that scroll at different speeds via JS */
.testi-cols{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1px;background:var(--border);margin-top:60px;height:640px;overflow:hidden}
.testi-col{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px;background:var(--border);will-change:transform}
.testi-col-a{animation:col-scroll-up 30s linear infinite}
.testi-col-b{animation:col-scroll-down 36s linear infinite}
@keyframes col-scroll-up{from{transform:translateY(0)}to{transform:translateY(-50%)}}
@keyframes col-scroll-down{from{transform:translateY(-50%)}to{transform:translateY(0)}}
.testi-card{background:var(--ink);padding:32px 36px;flex-shrink:0}
.testi-card:hover{background:var(--mist)}
.testi-quote{font-family:'Instrument Serif',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;color:rgba(242,237,230,.75);margin-bottom:20px}
.testi-author{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.testi-avatar{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--mist);border:.5px solid var(--border);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;flex-shrink:0}
.testi-name{font-size:11px;font-weight:500;color:var(--paper)}
.testi-role{font-size:10px;color:rgba(242,237,230,.3);letter-spacing:.06em;margin-top:2px}
.testi-stars{color:var(--acid);font-size:12px;margin-bottom:14px;letter-spacing:2px}
/* Hover pause */
.testi-col-a:hover{animation-play-state:paused}
.testi-col-b:hover{animation-play-state:paused}
/* ══════════════════════════════════════
SECTION: METRICS COUNTER
══════════════════════════════════════ */
.metrics{padding:120px 48px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.metrics-inner{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:1px;background:var(--border)}
.metric-cell{background:var(--ink);padding:48px 36px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:background .3s}
.metric-cell:hover{background:var(--mist)}
.metric-cell::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:transparent;transition:background .4s}
.metric-cell:hover::before{background:var(--acid)}
.metric-n{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(48px,5vw,72px);line-height:1;letter-spacing:.02em;color:var(--paper);display:block}
.metric-unit{color:var(--acid)}
.metric-label{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(242,237,230,.3);margin-top:8px}
.metric-sub{font-size:11px;color:rgba(242,237,230,.2);margin-top:6px;line-height:1.5}
/* count-up animation: JS handles this */
.metric-n[data-target]{color:rgba(242,237,230,.08)}
.metric-n.counted{color:var(--paper);transition:color .2s}
/* decorative bg number */
.metric-bg{position:absolute;right:16px;bottom:8px;font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:96px;color:rgba(242,237,230,.03);line-height:1;pointer-events:none}
/* ══════════════════════════════════════
SECTION: PROCESS — HORIZONTAL SCROLL
══════════════════════════════════════ */
.process{padding:120px 0 120px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.process-header{padding:0 48px;margin-bottom:60px}
.process-headline{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(48px,6vw,80px);line-height:.92}
.process-headline em{font-family:'Instrument Serif',serif;font-style:italic;color:rgba(242,237,230,.25)}
.process-track-wrap{overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:visible;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;padding:0 48px 32px;cursor:grab;user-select:none}
.process-track-wrap::-webkit-scrollbar{height:2px}
.process-track-wrap::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:var(--border)}
.process-track-wrap::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--acid)}
.process-track{display:flex;gap:1px;background:var(--border);width:max-content}
.process-card{background:var(--ink);padding:48px 40px;width:320px;flex-shrink:0;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:background .3s}
.process-card:hover{background:var(--mist)}
.process-card-num{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:96px;color:rgba(242,237,230,.04);line-height:1;position:absolute;right:20px;top:10px}
.process-card-step{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(242,237,230,.25);margin-bottom:20px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.process-card-step::before{content:'';display:block;width:20px;height:.5px;background:var(--acid)}
.process-card-title{font-family:'Instrument Serif',serif;font-style:italic;font-size:28px;color:var(--paper);line-height:1.2;margin-bottom:14px}
.process-card-body{font-size:11px;line-height:1.8;color:rgba(242,237,230,.38)}
/* Animated icon per card */
.process-icon{width:48px;height:48px;margin-bottom:28px;position:relative}
.pi-circle{stroke:rgba(242,237,230,.1);fill:none;stroke-width:.5}
.pi-arc{stroke:var(--acid);fill:none;stroke-width:1;stroke-dasharray:100;stroke-dashoffset:100;stroke-linecap:round}
.process-card:hover .pi-arc{animation:arc-draw .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) forwards}
@keyframes arc-draw{to{stroke-dashoffset:0}}
/* connector arrow between cards */
.process-arrow{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:48px;background:var(--ink);flex-shrink:0;color:rgba(242,237,230,.15);font-size:18px}
/* DIAGONAL CALLOUT */
.diagonal-section{position:relative;padding:100px 48px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--mist);clip-path:polygon(0 4%,100% 0,100% 96%,0 100%);margin:-40px 0;z-index:1}
/* ══ PRICING — INTERACTIVE CALCULATOR ══ */
.pricing{padding:120px 48px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.pricing-headline{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(48px,6vw,80px);line-height:.95;margin-bottom:16px}
.pricing-headline em{font-family:'Instrument Serif',serif;font-style:italic;color:rgba(242,237,230,.25)}
.pricing-sub{font-size:12px;color:rgba(242,237,230,.35);margin-bottom:48px;letter-spacing:.04em}
.pricing-toggle{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:48px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(242,237,230,.35);cursor:none}
.toggle-track{width:44px;height:24px;background:var(--border);border-radius:100px;position:relative;cursor:none;transition:background .3s;border:.5px solid rgba(242,237,230,.12)}
.toggle-track.on{background:var(--acid)}
.toggle-thumb{position:absolute;top:3px;left:3px;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--paper);transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),background .3s}
.toggle-track.on .toggle-thumb{transform:translateX(20px);background:var(--ink)}
.toggle-save{color:var(--acid);font-size:10px;opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s;background:rgba(212,255,71,.1);padding:3px 8px;border-radius:2px}
.annual-active .toggle-save{opacity:1}
.pricing-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:300px 1fr;gap:1px;background:var(--border);align-items:stretch;position:relative}
#priceCanvas{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:10}
.price-calc{background:#0c0c0c;padding:36px 32px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:24px}
.calc-title{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(242,237,230,.25);padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:.5px solid var(--border)}
.calc-label{font-size:11px;color:rgba(242,237,230,.4);margin-bottom:10px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}
.calc-val{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:20px;color:var(--acid);letter-spacing:.06em}
.calc-range{-webkit-appearance:none;appearance:none;width:100%;height:3px;background:var(--border);border-radius:2px;outline:none;cursor:none}
.calc-range::-webkit-slider-thumb{-webkit-appearance:none;width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--acid);cursor:none;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(212,255,71,.15);transition:box-shadow .2s}
.calc-range::-webkit-slider-thumb:hover{box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(212,255,71,.2)}
.calc-range::-moz-range-thumb{width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--acid);border:none;cursor:none}
.calc-ticks{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:5px}
.calc-tick{font-size:9px;color:rgba(242,237,230,.18);letter-spacing:.04em}
.calc-result{background:var(--ink);border:.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:4px;padding:20px;margin-top:4px;transition:border-color .3s}
.calc-result.highlight{border-color:rgba(212,255,71,.3)}
.calc-result-label{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(242,237,230,.25);margin-bottom:8px}
.calc-result-amt{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:52px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:.02em;color:var(--paper);display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:4px;overflow:hidden}
.calc-result-currency{font-size:22px;margin-top:6px;color:rgba(242,237,230,.4)}
.calc-result-per{font-size:11px;color:rgba(242,237,230,.3);margin-top:6px}
.calc-plan-badge{display:inline-block;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:4px 10px;background:rgba(212,255,71,.1);color:var(--acid);border-radius:2px;margin-top:12px;transition:all .3s}
/* Right side: horizontally scrollable card strip */
.price-cards-area{background:var(--ink);overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:hidden;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;padding:28px 24px;cursor:grab;user-select:none}
.price-cards-area::-webkit-scrollbar{height:3px}
.price-cards-area::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:rgba(242,237,230,.05);border-radius:2px}
.price-cards-area::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--acid);border-radius:2px}
.price-cards-track{display:flex;gap:16px;width:max-content;padding-bottom:8px}
.price-card-v{width:248px;flex-shrink:0;background:#0c0c0c;border:.5px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;padding:28px 24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:border-color .3s,transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1),background .3s;cursor:none}
.price-card-v:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);border-color:rgba(242,237,230,.25)}
.price-card-v.active{border-color:var(--acid);background:rgba(212,255,71,.03);transform:translateY(-4px)}
.price-card-v::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:transparent;transition:background .3s}
.price-card-v.active::before{background:var(--acid)}
.price-card-v .beam{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(212,255,71,.08),transparent 50%);opacity:0;transform:translateY(-100%);pointer-events:none}
.price-card-v.active .beam{animation:beam-sweep .6s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) forwards}
@keyframes beam-sweep{from{opacity:1;transform:translateY(-100%)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.pcv-badge{position:absolute;top:16px;right:16px;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--acid);background:rgba(212,255,71,.1);padding:3px 8px;border-radius:2px;opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.price-card-v.active .pcv-badge{opacity:1}
.pcv-tier{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(242,237,230,.3);margin-bottom:16px;transition:color .3s}
.price-card-v.active .pcv-tier{color:var(--acid)}
.pcv-amt{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:52px;line-height:1;letter-spacing:.02em;color:rgba(242,237,230,.45);transition:color .3s;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:3px}
.price-card-v.active .pcv-amt{color:var(--paper)}
.pcv-dollar{font-size:20px;margin-top:5px;opacity:.5}
.pcv-period{font-size:10px;color:rgba(242,237,230,.25);margin-top:5px;letter-spacing:.05em;min-height:14px}
.pcv-divider{height:.5px;background:var(--border);margin:20px 0}
.pcv-features{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;flex:1}
.prf{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:11px;color:rgba(242,237,230,.3);transition:color .3s;line-height:1.5}
.price-card-v.active .prf{color:rgba(242,237,230,.55)}
.prf-dot{width:4px;height:4px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(242,237,230,.15);flex-shrink:0;transition:background .3s}
.price-card-v.active .prf-dot{background:var(--acid)}
.prf-muted{opacity:.4}
.pcv-btn{display:block;padding:12px;margin-top:24px;font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;text-align:center;cursor:none;border-radius:2px;transition:all .25s;text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap;border:.5px solid rgba(242,237,230,.15);color:rgba(242,237,230,.35);background:transparent}
.price-card-v.active .pcv-btn{border-color:var(--acid);color:var(--ink);background:var(--acid);font-weight:500}
.pcv-btn:hover{border-color:rgba(242,237,230,.5);color:rgba(242,237,230,.7)}
.price-card-v.active .pcv-btn:hover{background:#fff;border-color:#fff}
.price-card-v.enterprise .pcv-amt{font-size:30px;margin-top:8px;letter-spacing:.03em}
/* scroll hint arrow */
.price-scroll-hint{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(242,237,230,.2);margin-top:12px;padding-left:24px}
.price-scroll-hint svg{animation:hint-slide 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes hint-slide{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}50%{transform:translateX(6px)}}
@keyframes digit-roll{0%{transform:translateY(50%);opacity:0}100%{transform:translateY(0);opacity:1}}
.rolling{display:inline-block;animation:digit-roll .28s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) forwards}
/* ══════════════════════════════════════
SECTION: CTA — CINEMATIC FULL-BLEED
══════════════════════════════════════ */
.cta-section{position:relative;min-height:80vh;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;text-align:center;padding:100px 48px}
/* Animated gradient mesh background */
.cta-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;overflow:hidden}
.cta-orb{position:absolute;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(80px);animation:orb-drift 12s ease-in-out infinite}
.cta-orb:nth-child(1){width:600px;height:600px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(212,255,71,.12),transparent 70%);top:-200px;left:-200px;animation-duration:15s}
.cta-orb:nth-child(2){width:500px;height:500px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(168,240,232,.08),transparent 70%);bottom:-100px;right:-100px;animation-duration:18s;animation-direction:reverse}
.cta-orb:nth-child(3){width:400px;height:400px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,61,90,.06),transparent 70%);top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);animation-duration:10s}
@keyframes orb-drift{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0)}33%{transform:translate(30px,-20px)}66%{transform:translate(-20px,30px)}}
/* Scanline grain overlay */
.cta-scan{position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,transparent,transparent 3px,rgba(0,0,0,.04) 3px,rgba(0,0,0,.04) 4px);pointer-events:none}
/* Large decorative text */
.cta-ghost{position:absolute;font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(100px,18vw,260px);color:rgba(242,237,230,.025);line-height:1;letter-spacing:.02em;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);white-space:nowrap;pointer-events:none;user-select:none}
.cta-inner{position:relative;z-index:2}
.cta-tag{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(242,237,230,.35);margin-bottom:32px;border:.5px solid var(--border);padding:8px 16px;border-radius:2px}
.cta-tag::before{content:'';width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--acid);animation:pulse-dot 2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes pulse-dot{0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}50%{opacity:.4;transform:scale(.6)}}
.cta-big{font-family:'Bebas Neue',sans-serif;font-size:clamp(64px,10vw,140px);line-height:.9;margin-bottom:24px}
.cta-big em{font-family:'Instrument Serif',serif;font-style:italic;color:var(--acid)}
.cta-sub{font-size:13px;line-height:1.8;color:rgba(242,237,230,.4);max-width:440px;margin:0 auto 40px}
.cta-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:20px}
/* border-drawing button */
.btn-draw{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:transparent;color:var(--paper);font-family:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:14px 28px;cursor:none;text-decoration:none;overflow:hidden}
.btn-draw::before,.btn-draw::after{content:'';position:absolute;background:var(--paper);transition:all .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.btn-draw::before{top:0;left:0;width:.5px;height:0}
.btn-draw::after{bottom:0;right:0;width:.5px;height:0}
.btn-draw span.edge-t,.btn-draw span.edge-b{position:absolute;height:.5px;background:var(--paper);transition:all .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.btn-draw span.edge-t{top:0;left:0;width:0}
.btn-draw span.edge-b{bottom:0;right:0;width:0}
.btn-draw:hover::before{height:100%}

    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/gsap.min.js"></script>

    <script>
      gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

      /* ── CURSOR ── */
      const cur=document.getElementById('cursor'),ring=document.getElementById('cursor-ring');
      let mx=0,my=0,rx=0,ry=0;
      document.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{mx=e.clientX;my=e.clientY;cur.style.left=mx+'px';cur.style.top=my+'px'});
      (function animRing(){rx+=(mx-rx)*.1;ry+=(my-ry)*.1;ring.style.left=rx+'px';ring.style.top=ry+'px';requestAnimationFrame(animRing)})();

      /* ── BG PARTICLES (global) ── */
      const canvas=document.getElementById('particle-canvas'),ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
      let W,H,pts=[];
      function resize(){W=canvas.width=window.innerWidth;H=canvas.height=window.innerHeight}
      resize();window.addEventListener('resize',resize);
      function initPts(){pts=[];const n=Math.floor(W*H/16000);for(let i=0;i<n;i++)pts.push({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,vx:(Math.random()-.5)*.25,vy:(Math.random()-.5)*.25,r:Math.random()*1.2+.3,a:Math.random()*.4+.08})}
      initPts();
      (function drawPts(){ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);pts.forEach(p=>{p.x+=p.vx;p.y+=p.vy;if(p.x<0)p.x=W;if(p.x>W)p.x=0;if(p.y<0)p.y=H;if(p.y>H)p.y=0;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(p.x,p.y,p.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=`rgba(212,255,71,${p.a})`;ctx.fill()});for(let i=0;i<pts.length;i++)for(let j=i+1;j<pts.length;j++){const dx=pts[i].x-pts[j].x,dy=pts[i].y-pts[j].y,d=Math.sqrt(dx*dx+dy*dy);if(d<90){ctx.beginPath();ctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(212,255,71,${.05*(1-d/90)})`;ctx.lineWidth=.4;ctx.moveTo(pts[i].x,pts[i].y);ctx.lineTo(pts[j].x,pts[j].y);ctx.stroke()}}requestAnimationFrame(drawPts)})();

      /* ══════════════════════════════════════════
         HERO CANVAS — Topographic noise field
         Layered sine-based contour lines that shift
         and breathe, creating a living landscape
         ══════════════════════════════════════════ */
      (function(){
        const hc=document.getElementById('hero-canvas');
        if(!hc)return;
        const hctx=hc.getContext('2d');
        let HW,HH,t=0;

        function resizeHero(){
          HW=hc.width=hc.offsetWidth;
          HH=hc.height=hc.offsetHeight;
        }
        resizeHero();
        window.addEventListener('resize',resizeHero);

        /* Simplex-like noise via layered sines */
        function noise(x,y,t){
          return(
            Math.sin(x*0.006+t*0.3)*0.4+
            Math.sin(y*0.008+t*0.2)*0.3+
            Math.sin((x+y)*0.005+t*0.15)*0.2+
            Math.sin(x*0.012-y*0.007+t*0.4)*0.1+
            Math.sin(x*0.003+y*0.009+t*0.1)*0.25+
            Math.cos(x*0.007-t*0.25)*0.15+
            Math.cos(y*0.011+t*0.18)*0.12
          )/1.52;
        }

        /* Marching squares contour extractor */
        function getContours(field,W,H,threshold){
          const lines=[];
          for(let y=0;y<H-1;y++){
            for(let x=0;x<W-1;x++){
              const tl=field[y*W+x],tr=field[y*W+x+1];
              const bl=field[(y+1)*W+x],br=field[(y+1)*W+x+1];
              const idx=((tl>threshold)?8:0)|((tr>threshold)?4:0)|((br>threshold)?2:0)|((bl>threshold)?1:0);
              if(idx===0||idx===15)continue;
              /* Interpolation helper */
              const lerp=(a,b)=>(threshold-a)/(b-a);
              const top={x:x+lerp(tl,tr),y};
              const bottom={x:x+lerp(bl,br),y:y+1};
              const left={x,y:y+lerp(tl,bl)};
              const right={x:x+1,y:y+lerp(tr,br)};
              const edges={1:[bottom,left],2:[right,bottom],3:[right,left],
                4:[top,right],5:[top,left,bottom,right],6:[top,bottom],
                7:[top,left],8:[top,left],9:[top,bottom],
                10:[left,top,right,bottom],11:[top,right],
                12:[left,right],13:[right,bottom],14:[left,bottom]};
              const pts=edges[idx]||[];
              if(pts.length>=2)lines.push([pts[0],pts[1]]);
              if(pts.length===4)lines.push([pts[2],pts[3]]);
            }
          }
          return lines;
        }

        const COLS=60,ROWS=40;

        function drawFrame(){
          t+=0.005;
          hctx.clearRect(0,0,HW,HH);

          /* Build field */
          const field=new Float32Array(COLS*ROWS);
          for(let row=0;row<ROWS;row++){
            for(let col=0;col<COLS;col++){
              const nx=col/COLS*HW,ny=row/ROWS*HH;
              field[row*COLS+col]=noise(nx,ny,t);
            }
          }

          const scaleX=HW/(COLS-1),scaleY=HH/(ROWS-1);

          /* Draw multiple threshold levels = contour lines */
          const levels=[
            {thr:-0.55,alpha:0.04,w:0.5,color:'212,255,71'},
            {thr:-0.35,alpha:0.06,w:0.5,color:'212,255,71'},
            {thr:-0.15,alpha:0.09,w:0.5,color:'212,255,71'},
            {thr:0.0, alpha:0.12,w:0.8,color:'168,240,232'},
            {thr:0.15,alpha:0.10,w:0.5,color:'212,255,71'},
            {thr:0.32,alpha:0.07,w:0.5,color:'212,255,71'},
            {thr:0.50,alpha:0.05,w:0.5,color:'242,237,230'},
          ];

          levels.forEach(({thr,alpha,w,color})=>{
            const lines=getContours(field,COLS,ROWS,thr);
            hctx.strokeStyle=`rgba(${color},${alpha})`;
            hctx.lineWidth=w;
            hctx.lineCap='round';
            lines.forEach(([p0,p1])=>{
              hctx.beginPath();
              hctx.moveTo(p0.x*scaleX,p0.y*scaleY);
              hctx.lineTo(p1.x*scaleX,p1.y*scaleY);
              hctx.stroke();
            });
          });

          /* Glowing accent dots at high-density intersections */
          const hotspots=[];
          for(let i=0;i<field.length;i++){
            const v=Math.abs(field[i]);
            if(v>0.42&&v<0.48&&Math.random()<0.003){
              const col=i%COLS,row=Math.floor(i/COLS);
              hotspots.push({x:col*scaleX,y:row*scaleY,v});
